Oceanfront Resort District.name: Oceanfront Resort District
Oceanfront Resort District.description: Atlantic Avenue hotel-and-entertainment strip between Rudee Inlet and 40th Street with relentless hotel renovation and height-driven permitting.

North End & Cape Henry.name: North End & Cape Henry
North End & Cape Henry.description: Guarded residential beach enclave of shingle-style homes from 52nd to 88th Street with teardown-and-rebuild pressure on oceanfront lots.

Cavalier Beach.name: Cavalier Beach
Cavalier Beach.description: Cavalier Hotel and Cardinal Road district mixing landmark-hotel restoration with premium condo infill at the North End gate.

Virginia Beach Town Center.name: Virginia Beach Town Center
Virginia Beach Town Center.description: The city's planned high-rise CBD around Pembroke Avenue and Constitution Drive with office towers, a Westin anchor, and the densest commercial pipeline.

Pembroke / Independence.name: Pembroke / Independence
Pembroke / Independence.description: Independence Boulevard office-and-retail spine north of Town Center absorbing older strip parcels into mixed-use redevelopment.

Lynnhaven Mall District.name: Lynnhaven Mall District
Lynnhaven Mall District.description: Regional-mall retail core at Virginia Beach Blvd and Independence with outparcel medical and hospitality refits.

Kempsville.name: Kempsville
Kempsville.description: Mature residential crossroads at Kempsville Road and Providence Road with steady additions, roof-and-HVAC trades, and neighborhood retail.

Princess Anne Plaza.name: Princess Anne Plaza
Princess Anne Plaza.description: Post-war plaza-and-ranch grid near the Municipal Center with municipal-adjacent services and investor renovation flow.

Indian Lakes.name: Indian Lakes
Indian Lakes.description: Golf-course community of lakeside colonials east of Kempsville with kitchen-and-deck renovation demand.

Shore Drive Corridor.name: Shore Drive Corridor
Shore Drive Corridor.description: Chesapeake Bay resort corridor from Lynnhaven Inlet to First Landing State Park with condo-repurposing and restaurant-row licensing.

Bayside & Little Neck.name: Bayside & Little Neck
Bayside & Little Neck.description: Working residential grid between Shore Drive and Independence with starter-stock turnover and accessory-dwelling interest.

Great Neck.name: Great Neck
Great Neck.description: Affluent peninsula of school-adjacent subdivisions and Deep Creek estates with high-value addition permitting.

Princess Anne Commons.name: Princess Anne Commons
Princess Anne Commons.description: Institutional growth node at the Aquarium and Sportsplex with the city's newest tract-housing and medical-office clusters.

Pungo.name: Pungo
Pungo.description: Rural-agricultural flats of field roads and farmettes under aggressive-by-right estate-lot conversion pressure.

Sandbridge.name: Sandbridge
Sandbridge.description: Barrier-island village of rental cottages and dune-line houses at the North Carolina line with storm-rebuild and elevation work.
